transcript: Main yahan pe aaj baith ke videos bana raha hun, but I was never like this. See there is a madhumakkhi here. But I was never like this. I was a shy student at 18. I learned how to speak better by making videos every single day, going for public speaking opportunities jab bhi mujhe dikhti thi. I've done over over 50 seminars in colleges with thousands of students, and is sab se na confidence milta hai ki theek hai I will fumble, but it's okay for me to fumble. I don't need to be perfect, and that is the awareness that you need to get confidence when you're speaking in front of people.
caption:
Confidence doesn’t come before you start. It comes because you start. 👀

Making videos, speaking in public and fumbling in front of people is what helped me get better.

You don’t need to be perfect. You just need to be okay with being imperfect while you improve. 🔥
